newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling strengthens as dollars sold.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling strengthens as dollars sold.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling strengthened against the dollar on Tuesday as speculators sold dollars, commercial bank dealers said.
"Most of the speculators were holding on to the dollars waiting to see how far the shilling would go," a dealer said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted the shilling on Tuesday at mean average of 54.78 against the dollar from 54.79 on Monday. Against the pound, it was posted at a mean average of 88.43 from 89.28.
On Monday, dealers forecast the shilling would strengthen this week when speculators started offloading their dollars.
The money market was liquid with many banks lending. Overnight rates were at between 18-25 levels from Monday's 24-25 percent.
